text:
emma_cs: Heads-up — Novaflow demo tomorrow 10:00 PDT. They're seeing elevated tail latency from EU. Can we provision a temporary allowlist + pin region to us-east for the demo? Renewal meeting is right after; if the demo stalls it's a risk. Need quick confirmation. @mike_eng @raj_cloud

mike_eng: On it. Can you drop the IPs and expected QPS?

emma_cs: IPs: 203.0.113.45/32, 198.51.100.23/32. Expected peak ~120 qps, sustained ~60 qps. Demo window ~45m.

raj_cloud: We can pin their tenant to us-east routing for the demo. Need approval for a temporary +2x rate window and a short concurrency bump (256 tokens). Ops runbook: set region_pin=us-east-1, add CIDRs to allowlist, create auto-revoke window.

cleo_ops: I'll handle the allowlist and rate window. Planned window: 2026-03-24T16:00Z -> 2026-03-24T18:00Z. Auto-revoke after window. @deploy-bot can you apply the changes in staging then prod after sanity?

deploy-bot: Accepted change request. Applying allowlist and routing pin in staging now, will promote after manual check. Change-ID: chg-64123. Logs: /deploys/chg-64123

mike_eng: After deploy, I'll run a short canary against the pin (burst tests + simple long-prompt tail-latency check). Will report metrics.

emma_cs: Thanks — also capture two feedback items to bring to the renewal: they want lower tail latency for long prompts, and a token-cost estimate post-demo for their finance team.

cleo_ops: Noted. I'll add both items to the renewal playbook and schedule a 20-min post-demo posture call with Novaflow.

mike_eng: Quick Q: can we bump their rate limit from 60r/s to 160r/s for the window? peak ~120 qps but API counts r/s. Confirm if that's safe.

raj_cloud: 160r/s ~ 9600 r/min — doable on our dedicated pool for a short window. Will attach 90% utilization alert and autoscale policy to the change.

emma_cs: Great, please confirm when done. :thumbsup:
